title: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches · Paper 1 (SL) — original full-format practice
subject: mathematics-analysis-approaches
instructions: Do not use a calculator. Answer every question in its digital working area, show all reasoning, and give exact values where requested. No separate answer sheet is used.

questions.label: Question 2 — sequences
questions.prompt: An arithmetic sequence has fifth term 18 and twelfth term 46. Find the first term and common difference, then determine the sum of the first 20 terms.

questions.label: Question 3 — calculus
questions.prompt: For f(x) = x³ − 3x² − 9x + 5, find the coordinates of both stationary points and classify each one.

questions.label: Question 4 — trigonometry
questions.prompt: Given that sin θ = 3/5 and π/2 < θ < π, find the exact values of cos θ and sin(2θ).

questions.label: Question 5 — logarithms
questions.prompt: Solve exactly log₂(x − 1) + log₂(x + 2) = 3, stating any rejected value.

questions.label: Question 6 — binomial theorem
questions.prompt: Find the coefficient of x³ in the expansion of (2 − x)⁶ and use the first four terms to approximate 1.99⁶.

questions.label: Question 7 — probability
questions.prompt: Events A and B satisfy P(A) = 0.62, P(B) = 0.45 and P(A ∪ B) = 0.79. Find P(A ∩ B), P(A | B), and determine whether A and B are independent.

questions.label: Question 8 — coordinate geometry
questions.prompt: The line 3x − 2y + 7 = 0 is tangent to a circle at P(1, 5). Find the equation of the circle if its centre lies on x + y = 2.

questions.label: Question 9 — functions
questions.prompt: Let f(x) = |2x − 3| − 1. Sketch y = f(x), solve f(x) = 2, and state the range of f.

questions.label: Question 10 — differentiation
questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet 24 cm by 16 cm has squares of side x removed from each corner and is folded into an open box. Find the value of x that maximizes the volume and justify that it is a maximum.

questions.label: Question 11 — proof
questions.prompt: Prove by mathematical induction that 1·2 + 2·3 + ··· + n(n + 1) = n(n + 1)(n + 2)/3 for every positive integer n.

questions.label: Question 12 — trigonometric modelling
questions.prompt: The depth d metres of water at a harbour is modelled by d(t) = 5.2 + 1.8 cos(πt/6), where t is hours after midnight. Find the first two times when d = 4.3 and the total time in the first 12 hours for which d is below 4.3.
